citationText: 11. The Kollmorgen Lens Selector was designed around the typical cinemas and lenses of the time. Lenses were 1 1/4 in. to 9 in. on the indoor side, with pictures sizes up to 50 ft. × 90 ft., and larger on the drive-in side. This design was copied about 1970 and marked with the name A. P. Goertz, a subsidiary of Kollmorgen, and copied again in 1973 by Schneider Corp. of America.
